intro: If you're in Nakhon Si Thammarat on business or passing through and want an in-town room that's spacious, clean, has parking and won't break the bank, iBiz Boutique Hotel is a name that comes up again and again in reviews · Guests keep mentioning rooms that feel bigger than the price suggests, soft comfortable beds, and a location that makes driving anywhere in town easy · It's a 44-room boutique hotel on Pattanakan-Kukwang Road, from approximately ฿950/night with breakfast included.

body.html: iBiz Boutique Hotel is a mid-sized 44-room boutique hotel in central Nakhon Si Thammarat on Pattanakan-Kukwang Road — a location that makes driving anywhere in town easy, close to malls and convenience stores with a McDonald's and Starbucks nearby · The first thing guests mention is rooms that feel bigger than expected, soft beds, and consistently good cleanliness, which is why many pick it as a one-night stop while travelling through.

The main rooms are Deluxe Double and Deluxe Twin at around 32 square metres — noticeably larger than the standard rooms at many hotels in the same class · They're done in warm tones with soundproof glass, flat-screen TVs, air conditioning and private bathrooms stocked with the essentials · Guests single out the soft beds and quiet rooms in particular, while the detail some reviews flag is that the furnishings and decor feel plainer than the word "boutique" might lead you to expect.
"The room was far bigger than I expected, the bed was really comfortable, and I could park right outside the door — perfect for a one-night stop before moving on."

What earns iBiz its solid scores is value and convenience · There's free private parking, free Wi-Fi throughout, a fitness centre and an airport transfer service — enough for travellers who drive in or come for business in town · Staff get praise for being friendly and helpful · The in-town location makes grabbing dinner or shopping easy, unlike the beachfront resorts over in Khanom where you need a car and have to plan meals ahead.

Breakfast is included in the rate, served as Thai dishes with local options — most guests say it's fair for the price and fills you up before you head out, though it's the one area some reviews wish had more variety; if you want a wider spread, the city has plenty of options a short drive away · The hotel restaurant serves Thai food, while alcohol is limited — there's no full bar, just a fridge at reception.

On location overall, iBiz sits about 10–15 minutes' drive from the old town and Wat Phra Mahathat Woramahawihan, and around 12 km from Nakhon Si Thammarat Airport — better suited to people who drive in or rent a car than those who want to walk to the old town from the door · Pattanakan-Kukwang Road is a residential-and-shops area, quieter than the Tha Wang district right in the centre, but the trade-off is easy parking and a lighter price · A score of 8.4 from 115 Trip.com reviews and a mid-pack TripAdvisor ranking reflect a hotel that nails the basics at an accessible price.

To be straight with you, iBiz isn't the design-forward boutique its name might suggest — its appeal is value, roomy spaces, soft beds, cleanliness and the convenience of parking, rather than atmosphere or striking decor · If you're after a beachfront or a resort with character, this isn't it · But if you're here on business, breaking up a drive, or using Nakhon Si Thammarat as a base before moving on, iBiz delivers what travellers actually need at a sensible price.

A tip from following the reviews here for a while: ask for an upper-floor or interior room for more quiet, since street-side rooms can catch some traffic noise · If you're driving, iBiz's edge is free parking right outside your room · During long weekends and festivals (such as Nakhon's Sart Duan Sip), prices rise and rooms fill fast, so book ahead and compare a few platforms before you confirm.

honestChecks: If you expect a design-forward boutique or a striking atmosphere — iBiz is value- and function-first with fairly plain decor → choose a more design-led stay if atmosphere is what you want.

If you have no car and want to walk the old town — the hotel is on Pattanakan-Kukwang Rd, 10–15 minutes' drive from the old town and Wat Phra Mahathat → pick a Tha Wang-area stay if you want to walk to the sights.
If you come during a long weekend or the Sart Duan Sip festival — prices rise and rooms fill fast → book ahead, compare platforms, and pick a free-cancellation rate first.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — iBiz Boutique Hotel Nakhon Si Thammarat

faq.q: Where is iBiz Boutique Hotel and what's nearby?
faq.a: It's at 243/83 Pattanakan-Kukwang Road, Nai Mueang, Mueang, Nakhon Si Thammarat · In town, close to malls and convenience stores with a McDonald's and Starbucks nearby · About 10–15 minutes' drive from Wat Phra Mahathat and the old town, and around 12 km from Nakhon Si Thammarat Airport.

faq.q: What are iBiz Boutique Hotel's room rates and types?
faq.a: From approximately ฿950/night for a Deluxe Double Room of around 32 sqm · Deluxe Twin around ฿1,000 · Superior around ฿1,100 · Family Room around ฿1,400 · Rates include breakfast and vary by date — always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is iBiz Boutique Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's great for travellers on business, stopping over for a night, or using Nakhon Si Thammarat as a base · Spacious, clean rooms, soft beds and free parking · Better suited to people who drive in than to those who want to walk to the old town from the door.

faq.q: Does iBiz Boutique Hotel have parking and breakfast?
faq.a: Yes · free private parking right outside the room, and breakfast is included as a Thai menu with local options · Most guests say breakfast is fair for the price but limited in variety; the city has plenty of options a short drive away if you want more.

faq.q: Are the rooms at iBiz Boutique Hotel spacious and quiet?
faq.a: Yes · Deluxe rooms are around 32 sqm, larger than many peers, with soundproof glass · Guests praise the soft beds and quiet rooms · Ask for an upper-floor or interior room for more quiet than a street-side room.

faq.q: When should I book, and is cancellation available?
faq.a: In normal periods rooms are usually available at short notice · But during long weekends and Nakhon's Sart Duan Sip festival, rooms fill fast and prices rise, so book ahead · All platforms offer free cancellation — pick that option if your plans aren't firm.
